# Every image the demo runs. `make images` pulls these in the lab (through your VPN/proxy, whose CA
# the lab trusts) and `make up` loads them into the kind nodes, so the cluster never pulls anything.
# All manifests and chart values use imagePullPolicy: Never.
#
# If you change a version in versions.env, change it here too (`make images` checks they match).

# NGINX Gateway Fabric (control plane + the NGINX data plane it provisions per Gateway)

ghcr.io/nginx/nginx-gateway-fabric/nginx:2.8.0
